SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.points_change), 0) FROM bbs_points_log p JOIN bbs_user u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE AND (p.is_reversed IS NULL OR p.is_reversed = 0) AND p.create_time >= #{startTime} AND p.create_time < CONCAT(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59')

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bbs_article a JOIN bbs_user u ON a.user_id = u.id WHERE AND a.is_delete = 0 AND a.enable = 1
AND a.create_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND a.create_time < STR_TO_DATE(#{endTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') + INTERVAL 1 DAY
AND to_date(a.create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= to_date(#{startTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND to_date(a.create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') < to_date(#{endTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + interval '1 day'

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bbs_comment c JOIN bbs_user u ON c.comment_user_id = u.id WHERE AND c.is_delete = 0 AND c.enable = 1
AND c.comment_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND c.comment_time < STR_TO_DATE(#{endTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') + INTERVAL 1 DAY
AND to_date(c.comment_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= to_date(#{startTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND to_date(c.comment_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') < to_date(#{endTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + interval '1 day'
